question: Should ClawSweeper adopt opt-in exact-review pressure as a supported scheduler input, and if so are the proposed 16/4 background caps and shared admission behavior the intended policy?
rationale: Tests can validate mechanics, but they cannot decide acceptable background deferral, operational thresholds, rollout ownership, or whether telemetry-only observability is sufficient.

options.title: Telemetry-first controlled trial
options.body: Land the observation-only subset, collect real queue and completion data, then narrow this PR to a measured policy with rollback criteria.

options.title: Sponsor the opt-in policy now
options.body: Keep this implementation direction but require maintainers to approve the thresholds and provide controlled live-run proof before merge.

options.title: Keep telemetry only
options.body: Close the scheduler experiment after preserving the observation work in https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/555.

recommendation.title: Telemetry-first controlled trial
recommendation.body: Land the observation-only subset, collect real queue and completion data, then narrow this PR to a measured policy with rollback criteria.

likelyOwner.reason: The telemetry extraction explicitly separates observation from scheduler policy and provides the clearest current ownership signal for this decision.
